changes: The COP preamble replaces recognition of LDC needs with a fuller reference to Article 4.9, recalling that Parties shall take full account of those needs regarding funding and technology transfer.
The COP draft replaces “technical guidance” with “technical assistance” in the national adaptation plan implementation-platform provision.

COP paragraph 10 explicitly identifies implementing agencies of the Least Developed Countries Fund. Paragraph 21 replaces forwarding “those recommendations” “for adoption” with forwarding “a recommendation” to COP’s November 2027 session.
CMA paragraph 9 explicitly identifies implementing agencies of the Least Developed Countries Fund, revising the earlier grouping with accredited entities and implementing agencies.
CMA paragraph 20 replaces forwarding “those recommendations” “for adoption” with forwarding “a recommendation” to CMA’s November 2027 session.
summary.significance: Removing “for adoption” makes the stated procedural destination less explicit about the intended decision outcome; it does not establish what Parties will decide.
summary.watch: Check whether subsequent drafts retain the revised recommendation wording.
